title: Luxembourg City & Luxembourg
dek: Three nights in the fortress city — ramparts and casemates in the upper town, a walk down into the Alzette valley, and one castle beyond the border of the trip's own ambition.
verified: ⚠ Draft — Pass A (canonical/verified) complete 2026-08-21, Pass B (local/authentic) and reconciliation still to come. Confirmed against primary/official sources: UNESCO-fortifications backbone (Bock Casemates, Chemin de la Corniche/Wenzel Walk), upper-town museums (MNHA, Musée Dräi Eechelen, Villa Vauban), the Pfaffenthal panoramic lift, nationwide free public transport since 1 Mar 2020, the Findel Airport bus link, Vianden Castle + its Ettelbrück/bus-181 connection, entry rules for a US passport, and the shipped food picks. Re-check before travel: the RGTR bus 181 timetable (the Ettelbrück hub reorganized 10 May 2026 — confirm current departure times the morning of), Mousel's Cantine's reservation policy for dinner, and every museum's Monday closure against the actual day plan. Not yet checked: the current US State Department travel advisory level (source is bot-gated against automated fetch) and native-language corroboration (Pass B).

entry.visa: Visa-free for tourism, stays up to 90 days within any 180-day period across the whole Schengen area.
entry.passportValidity: Valid at least 3 months beyond your Schengen departure date.
entry.note: A Schengen visa-free stay does not permit paid work. ETIAS pre-travel authorization is expected to start applying to visa-exempt visitors from late 2026 — confirm before booking if this trip slips past that date.
